The 'in every complexity band' wording contradicts the card, and the rationale asserts note-check findings (duplicates, repeated-time notes, cloned documentation) that are not on the card or in tool outputs shown.","problems":["Headline says 99215 is far above expected 'in every complexity band', but the 5+ band is 0.273 vs 0.275 all-provider (not above) and the 0-band is 0.033 vs 0.024 (only slightly above); the rationale's '0–4 bands' also overstates, since band 0 is barely above.","'17%' (problems share) could not be matched by the number check and is not on the evidence card; it is unverified.","'a notable share of duplicate and repeated-time notes that could reflect cloned documentation' is not supported by the card; the only listed rates are problems 17%, late 3%, data 3%, so the cloning claim is speculative.","Claims 'the 99214 below-level rate is also somewhat elevated' (15.4% vs 3.9% on 13 notes, 2 claims) which is mentioned with caveat but still thin.","C0087318 is cited as a 'low-complexity 99215 hard to justify on the claim alone' while it is documented as moderate MDM with 35 minutes; it is a below-level example, not strong evidence of low complexity, and it is mixed in with the undocumented-chart examples.","Next-step example claims (C0087061, C0087105) have no documentation and are mentioned only as generic low-complexity cases; the narrative's recommended claims (C0087246, C0087379) are not the ones in the structured next steps, which is inconsistent.","The 'pattern not explained by panel acuity' sentence conflicts with the hedged headline about not being resolved; the rationale is long and mixes support and concern."]}
